text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит runs the incredible race
of her
dreams and emerges a champion.
Cheers of
"Tickezo" echo throughout the
racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Immensely satisfied that she was able to
inspire
her fans, she promises to deliver
another heated
race at the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин and Бива Хаяхидэ
congratulate
Уиннинг Тикит on her
victory, but swear that
they won't lose
next time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит bursts into
uncontrollable tears,
passionately
thanking her rivals for their
contributions
to her victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
